notes.title: Quick mode and Ghost | New 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Welcome back time travelers, we've got some news for you. 

We're happy to announce you our [b]Patch 1.1[/b]. 

This patch will bring two new features and some various bug fixes. 

The new features will be available in the Settings menu and are called [b]Fast movement[/b] and [b]Preview next turn[/b]. This is essentially a quality of life improvement. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/e8e05014bad36671a8429730908d062b03483db6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/276db990652180e8e0f24f2c652aa2151f30b5ea.jpg[/img][/url]

[list]
[*][b]Fast movement[/b] is self-explanatory: this option will speed up a lot of animations and allow you to go through the levels much more quickly. 

[*] [b]Preview next turn[/b] will be activated by default for new users. This option will add a ghost trail of the next recorded move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/b1eb8361fc2eb65d162956b53bc0fd0c1715da95.gif[/img]
[/list]

If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, please join the official Pandaroo Interactive Discord : https://discord.gg/xNwmsgxk or use the community hub.

Thanks,

[b]The Pandaroo Interactive Team[/b]
